overall_notes: This paper focuses on event sequence modeling and generation using variational autoencoders with semi-supervised discrete latent variables. The main NLG task is event sequence generation, evaluated using perplexity and inverse narrative cloze accuracy. The paper does not use LLM judges or human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of redundant/informal items.
